rows.question: 2026年5月，分别列出每种产品型号的净销售额。

assessment.reason: 分组和数值与独立Python计算一致

rows.sql: SELECT "dp"."product_id" AS "product_id", "dp"."product_name" AS "product_name", SUM("foi"."amount" - COALESCE("fr"."total_refund", 0)) AS "net_sales" FROM "fact_order_item" AS "foi" JOIN "fact_order" AS "fo" ON "foi"."order_id" = "fo"."order_id" JOIN "dim_sku" AS "ds" ON "foi"."sku_id" = "ds"."sku_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "dp" ON "ds"."product_id" = "dp"."product_id" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "fact_refund"."item_id" AS "item_id", SUM("fact_refund"."amount") AS "total_refund" FROM "fact_refund" AS "fact_refund" GROUP BY "fact_refund"."item_id") AS "fr" ON "foi"."item_id" = "fr"."item_id" WHERE "fo"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) AND "fo"."paid_date" < CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE) AND "fo"."status" = '已支付' GROUP BY "dp"."product_id", "dp"."product_name" ORDER BY "product_id" LIMIT 1001

rows.question: 请核算2026年7月各型号在售出30天内的激活率，排除观察期不满30天的设备，给出分子、分母和百分数。

assessment.reason: 数值或返回字段不符，需要人工核查

rows.sql: WITH "sold_devices" AS (SELECT "b"."device_id" AS "device_id", "d"."product_id" AS "product_id", "o"."paid_date" AS "paid_date" FROM "fact_order" AS "o" INNER JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "i" ON "o"."order_id" = "i"."order_id" INNER JOIN "bridge_order_device" AS "b" ON "i"."item_id" = "b"."item_id" INNER JOIN "dim_device" AS "d" ON "b"."device_id" = "d"."device_id" WHERE "o"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-07-31' AS DATE) AND "o"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-09-16' AS DATE)), "activated_devices" AS (SELECT "s"."device_id" AS "device_id", "s"."product_id" AS "product_id", "s"."paid_date" AS "paid_date", "a"."activation_date" AS "activation_date" FROM "sold_devices" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "fact_device_activation" AS "a" ON "s"."device_id" = "a"."device_id" WHERE "a"."activation_date" IS NULL OR ("a"."activation_date" >= "s"."paid_date" AND "a"."activation_date" <= "s"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAY)) SELECT "activated_devices"."product_id" AS "product_id", COUNT(DISTINCT "activated_devices"."device_id") AS "denominator", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "activated_devices"."activation_date" IS NULL THEN "activated_devices"."device_id" END) AS "numerator", ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "activated_devices"."activation_date" IS NULL THEN "activated_devices"."device_id" END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT "activated_devices"."device_id"), 2) AS "activation_rate_pct" FROM "activated_devices" AS "activated_devices" GROUP BY "activated_devices"."product_id" ORDER BY "product_id" LIMIT 1001
